help:
Paper Reed CLI 0.0.1

Start here:
  paper-reed doctor             Check the local connection (read-only)
  paper-reed accounts           List authorized accounts
  paper-reed <command> --help   Show a JSON example

Read: accounts, folders, threads, search, thread-get, attachment-get
Drafts: draft-get, draft-create, draft-reply, draft-update, draft-attach, draft-detach, draft-send, operation-get
Rules: rules, rule-save, rule-delete, rules-reorder, rules-preview, rules-apply
Classification: classify, classify-auto
Local: pin, unpin, snooze, unsnooze, local-list, local-state, labels, label-create, label-update, label-delete, label-add, label-remove
Organize: mark-read, mark-unread, archive, spam, trash, restore-inbox, change-get, undo

JSON input: --input '{...}' or stdin. JSON output; errors exit 1.
Install/connect from Paper Reed → Settings → Agent. Keep the app running.
No mail is sent by installation or doctor. Sending requires permission and user approval.
sendRecoveryHint: Have an operationId? Use operation-get to check its status. If the receipt was lost before you got an operationId, repeat draft-send with exactly the original input, including expectedRevision and requestId.
